title: urnetwork / network stats
description: Public network measurements: live traffic and devices, the provider network by country, growth, the weekly subnet block, and alpha economics. Weekly block values reset at 00:00 UTC Sunday; the last-finished-block values are the previous block's final values. A missing optional measurement is shown as no data rather than as zero.

panels.title: data transferred
panels.description: Acknowledged bytes carried under transfer contracts in the dashboard time range, summed across the fleet. The instant query evaluates the range once; summing overlapping fixed windows would overcount. Change the time range (top right) to see other windows.

panels.title: connected devices
panels.description: Distinct client devices with a live resident on the connect fleet right now. A device can hold more than one transport connection, so this intentionally counts residents, not connections. The percentage is the change over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: live throughput
panels.description: Current relay data-frame rate across the connect fleet: completed exchange data frames written per second, including the fixed 4-byte frame header and excluding pings and handshakes. Sent is used alone because sent and received are two observations of the same inter-server traffic.

panels.title: connections / min
panels.description: Fresh (not already established) client connections announced to the fleet per minute — the network's session pulse. Reconnects after a fleet redeploy show as a short spike.

panels.title: online providers
panels.description: Connected providers holding a public provide key with a valid location — the same population as the public providers map. Only a public provide key makes a provider reachable outside its own network, so this is the supply a stranger can actually use.

panels.title: provider countries
panels.description: Countries with at least one connected, valid public provider. This is provider reach, not the locations of consuming devices.

panels.title: total networks
panels.description: Total networks (accounts) registered with this operator. Every taskworker publishes the same measurement, so max selects the value without multiplying it by the replica count.

panels.title: new networks (range)
panels.description: Networks registered during the dashboard time range: the total now minus the total at the start of the range. Shows no data when the range starts before the measurement history.

panels.title: users last 24 hours
panels.description: Unique top-level identities that created transfer contracts (moved data) in the last 24 hours. Use by a child client, such as a hosted proxy's egress clients, counts for its top-level parent.

panels.title: users this block
panels.description: Unique top-level identities with contract usage since the current weekly block opened (00:00 UTC Sunday). Resets when the block rolls over; the last finished block's final count is under the weekly block section.

panels.title: alpha price
panels.description: Alpha price in US dollars from the operator's server-side market observation (the subnet pool on GeckoTerminal). The percentage is the change over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: current block
panels.description: The current subnet block number. Blocks are 1-based, 7 days long, and open and close at 00:00 UTC Sunday; block 1 opened 2026-06-28.

panels.title: live exchange throughput
panels.description: Current completed exchange data-frame write rate across the fleet, including the fixed 4-byte exchange frame header and excluding pings and handshakes. Sent is used alone because fleet sent and received are two observations of the same inter-server traffic.

panels.title: data transferred per day
panels.description: Acknowledged bytes carried under transfer contracts per complete UTC day; each bar covers the day ending at its right edge, and the current day appears once it closes. Contract bytes land when a contract closes or checkpoints.

panels.title: connected devices
panels.description: Distinct resident client devices, summed across the connect fleet.

panels.title: new connections per minute
panels.description: Fresh client connections announced to the fleet per minute. A spike right after a fleet redeploy is clients reconnecting to the new processes.

panels.title: providers by country
panels.description: Connected valid public providers per country. Marker size and color scale with the provider count; hover a marker for the country and its count. Countries with no connected public provider have no marker.

panels.title: top provider countries
panels.description: The 15 countries with the most connected valid public providers right now.

panels.title: provider share by country
panels.description: Share of connected valid public providers in the six largest countries; every other country is folded into one slice.

panels.title: online providers
panels.description: Connected valid public providers over time (refreshed every five minutes).

panels.title: provider countries
panels.description: Countries with at least one connected, valid public provider.

panels.title: provider regions
panels.description: Distinct regions (states, provinces) with at least one connected, valid public provider.

panels.title: provider regions
panels.description: Distinct regions with a connected valid public provider over time.

panels.title: provider cities
panels.description: Distinct cities with at least one connected, valid public provider.

panels.title: provider cities
panels.description: Distinct cities with a connected valid public provider over time.

panels.title: total networks
panels.description: Total networks registered with this operator, over time.

panels.title: new networks per day
panels.description: Networks registered per complete UTC day: the total at the end of each day minus the total one day earlier; each bar covers the day ending at its right edge. Empty until a full day of measurement history exists.

panels.title: weekly users
panels.description: Unique users per weekly block. The current block climbs from zero every Sunday 00:00 UTC; the last finished block is the stable reference and steps once per week.

panels.title: users last 24 hours
panels.description: Unique top-level identities with contract usage in the trailing 24 hours, refreshed every five minutes.

panels.title: weekly block: current block vs last finished block
block progress
panels.description: How far the current 7-day subnet block has progressed. Blocks open and close at 00:00 UTC Sunday.

panels.title: time elapsed in block
panels.description: Time since the current block opened.

panels.title: time left in block
panels.description: Time until the current block closes and the next one opens.

panels.title: next block opens (UTC)
panels.description: When the current block closes and the next block opens. Always a Sunday at 00:00 UTC.

panels.title: users: this block vs last block
panels.description: Unique users so far in the current block against the final count of the last finished block. The last finished block is expected to be missing until a complete block has been observed.

panels.title: demand deposits: this block vs last block
panels.description: Alpha demand deposited during the current weekly block against the last finished block.

panels.title: miner emissions: this block vs last block
panels.description: Alpha miner emission captured during the current weekly block against the last finished block.

panels.title: miner claims: this block vs last block
panels.description: Alpha claimed by miners during the current weekly block against the last finished block.

panels.title: miners claiming: this block vs last block
panels.description: Distinct miner coldkeys that claimed alpha during the current weekly block against the last finished block.

panels.title: this block in USD
panels.description: The current block's demand deposits, miner emissions, and miner claims valued at the current alpha price.

panels.title: weekly demand deposits
panels.description: Alpha demand deposits per weekly block: the current block accumulates from zero every Sunday 00:00 UTC; the last finished block steps once per week.

panels.title: weekly miner emissions
panels.description: Alpha miner emission captured per weekly block.

panels.title: weekly miner claims
panels.description: Alpha claimed by miners per weekly block.

panels.title: alpha price change (24h)
panels.description: Alpha price now against 24 hours ago, from the operator's server-side market observation. Green is up, red is down.

panels.title: total alpha staked (α)
panels.description: Cumulative alpha staked in the subnet contract (buybackTotal). The percentage is the change over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: staked value
panels.description: Total alpha staked in the subnet contract valued at the current alpha price.

panels.title: alpha price change (7d)
panels.description: Alpha price now against seven days ago. Green is up, red is down.

panels.title: alpha price
panels.description: Alpha price in US dollars over time, sampled every minute by the operator.

panels.title: total alpha staked (α)
panels.description: Cumulative alpha staked in the subnet contract over time.

options.content:
**urnetwork network stats** — public, read-only, refreshed every minute from the operator's live fleet. Change the time range at the top right (up to 90 days of history are kept).

- **Data transferred** counts bytes carried under transfer contracts and acknowledged by the receiving side — the same bytes the network settles on. Relayed traffic is counted per contract leg, so quote it as *bytes carried*, not bytes downloaded.
- **Connected devices** are distinct client devices with a live resident on the fleet; **users** are unique top-level identities that moved data in the window.
- **Providers** are devices with a public provide key, a valid location, and a live connection — the supply anyone on the network can use. Countries, regions, and cities are where those providers are, not where users are.
- **Weekly blocks** are the subnet block clock: 7 days each, opening and closing at 00:00 UTC Sunday (block 1 opened 2026-06-28). Block values reset at rollover; the *last finished block* is the final value of the previous block.
- **Alpha** figures come from the subnet contract and its event mirror (demand deposits, miner emissions, miner claims, staked total) and the alpha price from the subnet pool on GeckoTerminal. USD values are informational: amount × current price.
- A measurement without a value shows *No data* rather than zero — for example the last finished block until one has been observed since deploy.

The same figures back the machine-readable [`/stats.json`](/stats.json) feed and the [public dashboards directory](/stats).
